name: Thoughts
overview: Scripture reveals that our thoughts hold great significance, as God’s own thoughts toward us are precious and numerous (Psalms 139:17), and the meditation of our hearts should be acceptable to Him (Psalms 19:14). Believers are called to guard their hearts diligently, for from them flow the issues of life (Proverbs 4:23), and to keep their minds focused on God to experience perfect peace (Isaiah 26:3). The contrast between fleshly and spiritual thinking underscores the need to control and purify our thoughts, offering ourselves as living sacrifices holy and acceptable to God (Romans 8:5; Romans 12:1).
